fields.mechanism: Binary interactions of precipitates and particulates physically blocking the flow path, which correlates with clogging severity more than root intrusion alone.
fields.intervention: Install a multi-stage mechanical filtration unit at the emitter inlet designed specifically to remove the size fraction of soil particulates that form binary aggregates with chemical precipitates, thereby preventing the physical matrix that facilitates minor root entry.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction of slight and partial clogging events by disrupting the precipitate-particulate interaction, maintaining flow uniformity without chemical treatment.
fields.falsification_test: Operate filtered and unfiltered emitters in root-dense soil for 12 months; if the filtered emitters show clogging rates statistically equivalent to unfiltered ones, the precipitate-particulate interaction mechanism is not the primary driver for this specific failure mode.
fields.mechanism_source_span: The binary interactions of precipitates - particulates contributed 26.6%, and ternary interactions of precipitates - particulates - biofouling contributed 46.1% to sugarcane SDI emitter clogging.
